name: Arena-Hard-Auto
intro: Arena-Hard-Auto 是一个自动化构建的基准测试，它利用 BenchBuilder 流水线从大规模众包数据（如 Chatbot Arena）中筛选出500个具有挑战性的开放式提示。该基准旨在通过LLM作为裁判进行自动化评估，以衡量和区分前沿语言模型的性能，并确保与人类偏好高度相关。
build_method: 众包提示挖掘、LLM辅助筛选与标注
metric: 胜率、95%置信区间、带置信度可分离性、带置信度一致性、Pair Rank Brier Score
build_method_en: Crowdsourced prompt mining, LLM-assisted filtering and annotation
intro_en: Arena-Hard-Auto is an automatically constructed benchmark that uses the BenchBuilder pipeline to select 500 challenging open-ended prompts from large-scale crowdsourced data such as Chatbot Arena. This benchmark aims to measure and differentiate the performance of state-of-the-art language models through automated evaluation with LLMs as judges, ensuring high correlation with human preferences.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.11939, Sections 4-6 and Appendix A.2. BenchBuilder starts from 200,000 Chatbot Arena prompts, removes duplicates, multi-turn conversations, and non-English content, and uses text-embedding-3-small, UMAP, and HDBSCAN to form 4,000 topics. GPT-4-Turbo scores seven prompt qualities; prompts below 6 and clusters with mean below 5 are discarded. Two prompts are sampled from each of 250 randomly selected high-quality clusters, then PII and offensive content are removed to produce 500 prompts. A separate 200-query audit uses majority labels from GPT-4o, Claude-3-Opus, and Gemini-1.5-Pro and finds 85.6% agreement with GPT-4-Turbo. Evaluation compares candidate and baseline answers in two CoT judge games with swapped positions, yielding 1,000 judgments per model. Bradley-Terry fitting, bootstrapped confidence intervals, optional style controls, separability, confidence agreement, Brier score, and Chatbot Arena alignment form the evaluation report.
